title: Contact details finder
description:
Find email addresses and phone numbers in a block of text with regular expressions.

```
Emails:
  ada@example.com
  bob.smith@mail.example.org
Phone numbers:
  555-0142
  555-0199
```

starter.main.py:
import re

text = """
Write to ada@example.com or call 555-0142.
Bob (bob.smith@mail.example.org) is on 555-0199, or 555-0142 for the office.
Not an email: someone@ or @example.com
"""
